title: python/src/lichen/loadng/messages.py: Missing hop_limit range validation on parsing
description: Line 95: RREQ.from_bytes() reads hop_limit as a raw byte (0-255) without validating against MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15). The to_bytes() method validates this (line 74-75), but from_bytes() does not. A malicious sender can inject hop_limit values 16-255 that violate the spec. If downstream routing code assumes the constraint holds, this could cause logic errors.
